title: Remote hosts
description: Saved SSH hosts can be reused by any session; credentials are encrypted on this machine.

empty.title: No saved hosts yet
empty.description: Add a remote Linux host and the agent can operate it from a chat session.

form.name: Display name
form.privateKeyPlaceholder: Paste the private key (PEM / OpenSSH), or leave blank to keep the stored one.
form.sudoHint: Injected on the remote sudo prompt; the agent never sees it. Leave blank for passwordless sudo.
form.secretKept: A value is stored. Leave as is to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.

pill.sudoStored: A sudo password is stored for this host.
pill.sudoMissing: No sudo password stored — sudo must be passwordless.
pill.noLink: This session has no live link to the host yet.
pill.droppedHint: Commands cannot reach the host until the link is back. If it does not return on its own, check the credentials and the host key.
pill.droppedActionRequired: This link will not come back on its own. Open 「Settings → Remote hosts」 to fix this host's credentials, or — if its host key changed — to review and trust the new key before reconnecting.
pill.unconfirmedExit: The remote shell could not be confirmed as exited — a process may still be running on the host.

delete.confirm: Delete this host? Sessions bound to it must be removed first.

validation.passwordRequired: A password is required for password authentication.
validation.privateKeyRequired: A private key is required for this authentication method.
